subject: SOC 2 Type II: initial evidence onboarding & quick-reply kit
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II - initial evidence onboarding and what to share

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As discussed, Acme’s procurement team asked for our most recent SOC 2 Type II report plus a small package of supporting artifacts so you can complete your internal review. To keep this low-friction we put together a short "starter kit" and a couple of quick reply templates you can use with any internal stakeholders.

What we typically provide up-front (minimal, gated):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — full report with scope and opinion
- Bridge letter (if the report period doesn't fully overlap your required window) — short note explaining period/controls coverage
- Evidence sampler (small set of non-sensitive artifacts): policy snapshots, retention matrix, recent change-control ticket sample, and an audit log snippet (redacted)

If you want the full evidence set we can arrange a controlled transfer (S3 presigned links or SFTP) and a short NDA/Access Acceptance form. For fast internal reviews, the starter kit usually satisfies security questionnaires and procurement checks.

Attached are: request template you can forward, a minimal evidence sample sheet, and short instructions for presigned S3 transfer.

Next steps (suggested):
1) Reply with the audit period you care about (e.g., Jan 1 2024 — Dec 31 2024).
2) Tell us your preferred share method: presigned S3 or SFTP.
3) If you need any redaction (PII, customer names) flag that up and we’ll surface a redacted bundle or deliver a bridge note.

One-line template (if helpful):
"Hi security team — ACME requested Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report + starter evidence pack. Please confirm audit window and preferred transfer method. I will ping Redwood for presigned link if approved"

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if useful.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Sr. Security Partner, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear note and the templates — very helpful. A couple quick Qs from our side before we proceed:

1) Audit period: we primarily need coverage that includes Q3–Q4 2024 (roughly Jul 1 2024 — Dec 31 2024). Will your Type II report cover that window, or would we need a bridge letter?

On Wed, Mar 18, 2025 at 10:03 AM Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@acme-analytics.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the clear note and the templates — very helpful. A couple quick Qs...

Hi Laura — quick answers inline and next steps below.

1) Audit period: Our latest Type II report covers the period Apr 1 2024 — Oct 31 2024. That overlaps Q3–Q4 2024 but ends before Dec 31. We can provide a short bridge letter that explains the audit window and any control carry-forward notes (standard practice).

2) Redaction: the starter evidence sampler contains only redacted log snippets and policy screenshots with customer identifiers removed. If you need additional logs, we have a redaction workflow and can produce a version with hashed identifiers.

3) Transfer options: we support both. For one-off quick reviews we usually deliver the report + bridge letter via email (PDF) and provide presigned S3 links for the evidence sampler. For whole-folder transfers we can enable a time-limited SFTP account (we'll need a contact and an IP allowlist if required).

Action items I can take now:
- Send the SOC 2 Type II report PDF + bridge letter for Apr 1 2024 — Oct 31 2024 (email delivery).
- Generate presigned S3 bundle for the starter evidence pack (48h expiry).
- Loop in Marissa (compliance delivery) to coordinate SFTP if you prefer.

If you confirm SFTP, Marissa will send an enrollment form (username key preference) and an IP allowlist request. Otherwise I'll push the PDF + presigned link today.

Best,
Mateo
